name: linear-devotee
description: Linear planning grounded in issue scope, source Acceptance, repository behavior, and independently reviewed deliverables, with recoverable verified project creation.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and create Linear work from Codex
interface.longDescription: Linear Devotee briefs issues with decision sources, plans only their assigned Acceptance, and reviews actual integration and observable verification. Project drafting produces complete deliverables, meaningful milestones, and justified dependencies without arbitrary issue-count limits. Creation replays the authorized complete payload, recovers by exact markers, and verifies the resulting graph. Existing authorization carries through scoped handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Use Linear Devotee to brief this Linear issue before implementation.
Use Linear Devotee to create a project, milestones, and issues from this spec.
Use Linear Devotee to recommend the next issue after this one is done.
